partially_covered.missing: Cannot filter memberships by temporal point ('at a certain point in time'). Need to query by date range against membershipStart/membershipEnd, but no convenience mechanism for point-in-time queries
Same temporal filtering issue as CQ2. Can retrieve role via BandMembership but filtering by exact time point requires manual date comparison
AlbumRecording class exists with recordingStart/recordingEnd, but no direct link from Album to Band. Cannot determine which band recorded the album
SongComposition with composedOn exists, but no link to composer (Person). Cannot answer 'who composed' questions
Critique class exists with critiqueText and critic, but no direct object property from Critique to Album. Need bidirectional query capability
PerformanceSong class exists but only links to Song. Story mentions 'songs from Stadium Arcadium' - need to track which specific tracks/album versions were performed

cq_coverage.details: Strong coverage for basic structural queries (instruments, tracks, locations, hierarchy). Temporal queries partially supported but lack point-in-time filtering mechanisms. Missing some key relationships: Album-to-Band recording link, Song-to-Composer link, and Track-specific performance tracking. CQ15 constraint fully implemented via owl:minQualifiedCardinality restriction.

strengths: Excellent reification pattern implementation for temporal relationships
Complete inverse property definitions for all object properties
All classes and properties properly annotated with labels and comments
Appropriate use of qualified cardinality restrictions (Album containsTrack, TrackInAlbum track)
Good disjointness axioms preventing basic modeling errors
Functional property correctly applied to trackCount
weaknesses: Flat class hierarchy - no subclass relationships utilized (e.g., Critic could be subclass of Person)
No General Class Axioms (GCAs) for complex class definitions
No owl:equivalentClass definitions for necessary and sufficient conditions
Missing domain/range restrictions on several key relationships
Limited property characteristics (no transitivity for inRegion/inCountry chain, no symmetry where applicable)
No owl:allValuesFrom or owl:someValuesFrom restrictions beyond cardinality
Disjoint axioms are present but incomplete (e.g., Person disjoint with Critic, but Critic could be Person subclass)

likely_oops_pitfalls: P11: Missing domain or range in properties (some reification properties lack explicit constraints)
P13: Inverse relationships not explicitly defined (actually NOT present - all inverses are defined)
P22: Using different naming conventions (mix of camelCase detected: some properties start lowercase, classes uppercase - actually consistent, low risk)
reasoner_risks: Low risk overall - ontology is conservative and reasoner-friendly
Qualified cardinality restrictions may slow Pellet on large datasets but are well-formed
No problematic circular definitions or unsatisfiable classes detected

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add object property :recordedBy from AlbumRecording to Band to support CQ4. This enables queries about which band recorded an album during a specific time period.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Completes CQ4 coverage from 70% to 100%. Essential for story scenario (RHCP recording Stadium Arcadium).

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add object property :composedBy from SongComposition to Person to identify the composer. Supports fuller CQ8 answering.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Increases CQ8 coverage from 60% to 95%. Aligns with typical music metadata requirements.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Consider adding :performedTrack object property from PerformanceSong to Track (in addition to :performedSong to Song). This distinguishes between abstract songs and specific album recordings performed live.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Increases CQ11 coverage from 70% to 100%. Addresses story detail about 'songs from Stadium Arcadium' being performed.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Make Critic a subclass of Person rather than disjoint. Critics are people who critique albums, not a separate entity type.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: More accurate domain modeling. Reduces redundancy and aligns with real-world semantics. Updates disjointness axioms accordingly.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add property chain axiom: City inRegion o Region inCountry → City inCountry (implied). Use owl:propertyChainAxiom to enable transitive geographic queries.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables queries like 'what country is Portland in' without explicit triple. Richer inferencing capability.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:equivalentClass definition for CurrentBandMember using GCA: Person and (personMembership some (BandMembership and (not exists membershipEnd))). Defines current members as those with open-ended memberships.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Supports automatic classification of current vs. former members. Addresses CQ2/CQ3 temporal filtering partially through inference.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add domain/range restrictions on reification linking properties: memberPerson/memberBand should have explicit domains. Add owl:allValuesFrom restrictions where appropriate.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Stronger ontology validation. Catches modeling errors earlier. Minimal performance impact.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add data property :trackNumber to TrackInAlbum (xsd:positiveInteger, Functional) to support ordering and counting queries. Current trackCount on Album is aggregate but doesn't support 'which is track 5?' queries.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables positional track queries. Better supports CQ5 variations about specific track retrieval.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add subclass hierarchy: Instrument subclasses like StringInstrument, PercussionInstrument, WindInstrument. Similarly for Role: Vocalist, Instrumentalist, etc.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Richer taxonomy enables category-level queries ('who plays string instruments?'). Optional enhancement beyond core CQs.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:FunctionalProperty characteristic to :memberPerson, :memberBand, :track, :composedSong, :recordedAlbum (each reification instance links to exactly one entity). Currently only trackCount marked functional.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Stronger logical constraints. Enables reasoner to detect duplicate assertions as errors.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:AsymmetricProperty characteristic to geographic containment (:inRegion, :inCountry) - regions cannot contain themselves or their containers.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Prevents circular geographic relationships. Improves data integrity validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:versionInfo and dc:creator annotations to ontology header for better provenance tracking.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Better ontology metadata. No functional impact but improves reusability and OOPS P08 score.

summary: This is a well-structured ontology with excellent reification patterns, complete annotations, and OWL 2 DL compliance. The core constraint adherence is flawless. Coverage is strong for structural queries (78%) but temporal point-in-time queries need enhancement. Key missing relationships: Album-to-Band recording link, Song-to-Composer attribution, and Track-specific performance tracking. Quality is good (0.72) but could reach 0.85+ with class hierarchies, GCAs, and property chain axioms. No critical validator risks identified. Priority improvements focus on completing CQ coverage through additional object properties, then enhancing quality through subsumption hierarchies and advanced OWL constructs.
